acceptance_checks: configure_workflow_permissions() in scripts/shiki_github.py PUTs repos/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow with default_workflow_permissions=read and can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true, warns (not raises) on failure

cmd_bootstrap_github and cmd_init call configure_workflow_permissions within the --protect block after protect_branch; bootstrap_dry_run_lines emits a workflow-permissions line (and a skip note under --no-protect)
tests/test_workflow_permissions_payload.py asserts the payload and passes under 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests'
scripts/test_shiki_init.sh and scripts/test_shiki_start.sh stub and assert the new gh api actions/permissions/workflow PUT
docs/adr/ ADR records the can_approve_pull_request_reviews bootstrap default and CCA Review Bridge / solo-maintainer security tradeoff
validate_shiki and all required checks are green
non_goals: Changing branch protection payload, required checks, or any target repo directly
Hard-failing bootstrap when the API rejects the call

findings.detail: docs/adr/README.md:42 adds '<!-- cca probe (throwaway, will be closed) -->' and the branch includes commit 0af0f66 ('CCA probe PR (throwaway)'). The author explicitly marked these as throwaway/to-be-closed, but they are part of git diff main...HEAD and would merge into main. Unrelated to the auto-grant-actions-permission task. Remove the README comment and the probe commit before opening the PR. Not a correctness/security issue, so non-blocking, but it should not ship.
findings.title: Throwaway CCA-probe artifact included in the diff to main

scope: Add configure_workflow_permissions(repo, *, can_approve_pull_requests=True, default_permissions='read', provider_config=None) to scripts/shiki_github.py, mirroring protect_branch's 'gh api ... -X PUT --input -' pattern: target repo_api_path(config,'actions/permissions/workflow') with JSON body {default_workflow_permissions, can_approve_pull_request_reviews}; info() on success, warn() (NOT raise) on failure with remediation text. Import+call it in scripts/shiki_bootstrap.py cmd_bootstrap_github and cmd_init immediately after protect_branch inside the 'if args.protect:' block. Add a dry-run line in bootstrap_dry_run_lines ('workflow-permissions: allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' when protect, and a skip note under --no-protect). Add tests/test_workflow_permissions_payload.py (python unittest, mirror tests/test_branch_protection_payload.py) asserting the PUT path and payload. Update scripts/test_shiki_init.sh and scripts/test_shiki_start.sh gh stubs to accept+assert the new actions/permissions/workflow PUT. Add an ADR under docs/adr/ recording the bootstrap can_approve_pull_request_reviews default and its CCA-Review-Bridge / solo-maintainer security tradeoff (relates to G-0012 / closed #106). Keep scoped; warn-not-fail; default_workflow_permissions=read.
title: Auto-grant Actions create/approve-PR permission in shiki bootstrap
